quote: Data centers must bring their own power.
context: NewsNation interview; first on-record framing of 'bring your own power'.

quote: I established clear guardrails to ensure data centers protect our electric grid, conserve our water, respect our neighborhoods, and pay their own way.
context: Statement announcing Microsoft, Hut 8 and Equinix compliance commitments.

quote: Simply put, Texans must come first... Data centers must pay their own way, protect our grid and water, and complete the ERCOT and TWDB audits. Until they do, TCEQ will issue no permits sought by data center projects.
context: Directive to TCEQ halting data-center permits pending audits.

politician: Andrew Mahaleris (press secretary to Gov. Abbott)
quote: Any project that fails those standards will be denied.
context: Statement to Inside Climate News on the governor's data-center standards.

quote: When I am governor I will issue a moratorium — a ban — on all data center approvals until laws can be passed by the Legislature to protect Texans.
context: Campaign video posted on X.

quote: We will put a pause and moratorium on any approvals.
context: El Paso campaign stop.

quote: So I don't hate data centers. I just hate the way they're taking advantage of Texans.
context: Austin press conference on data centers.

quote: The voters have delivered a mandate for change.
context: Victory speech; pause pledge reiterated as applying to new approvals, not projects already under construction.

quote: We are all paying for the data centers to be here.
context: Post-election interview on first-100-days plans.

quote: I think we all just stop right now.
context: Wichita Falls stop; called for a 'real' moratorium through the January 2027 session.
source_name: Times Record News via USA Today network

quote: As I've told the data center industry, this is your Bud Light moment. You've really messed up.
context: Lubbock stop; said communities should have the right to decide whether a data center is built.

quote: It's clear the overwhelming number of witnesses in rural Texas are not supportive of the current process. They want it paused. Some want it stopped entirely.
context: Statement urging PUCT to reject pending 765-kV transmission applications.

quote: Whether it was about affordability, gas prices, data centers, 765-kV lines, or any other issue important to them, I respect how the people voted.
context: Concession statement after losing to Vikki Goodwin.

quote: Time to end the subsidies to the data center companies.
context: Campaign position; also said data centers must pay their fair share and not push transmission costs to ratepayers.

quote: I believe it is appropriate for the Ohio Tax Credit Authority to pause its consideration of new data center tax exemptions while the full impact of data center growth in Ohio is being reviewed.
context: Statement pausing new data-center sales-tax exemptions.

quote: Cut a good deal. The deal is in your hands... We can't throw them completely out and say 'we want to close the walls of the state of Ohio.' This is where the future is.
context: Remarks to reporters at Rockefeller Foundation summit, Cleveland.

quote: That will continue until I leave office.
context: On the frozen data-center sales-tax exemption; decision left to next governor.

quote: Costs are too high, and Ohio families and businesses need protection from data centers driving up costs... If you do not meet these conditions, we do not want you in Ohio.
context: Statement announcing 'conditional moratorium' platform.

quote: I'm very open for business, but we are not for sale in Ohio. My stance on data centers is a conditional moratorium immediately in effect to protect our energy needs.
context: Remarks to reporters after Marietta campaign stop.

quote: Ohioans have been clear; we need to lower costs, which is why I am calling on our Statehouse to pass a conditional moratorium on data centers when they return to session next week.
context: Press release urging immediate legislative action.

quote: I've called for a conditional moratorium very early in this campaign. We can't have companies coming in the dark of night. Communities deserve to know what businesses are coming to their community, and have a say in that.
context: WVXU Cincinnati Edition interview.

quote: I'm not saying we need a data center in every community that's out there, but to have a moratorium — just like the governor of New York did, and what Keisha Lance Bottoms is proposing — to me, is irresponsible... We're making the hyperscalers pay.
context: POLITICO Energy video interview.

quote: We don't need to take another step forward in this state until we fully understand what the impact will be on consumers and what the impact will be on people across Georgia.
context: Marietta press conference launching statewide pause proposal.

quote: Georgia is currently No. 1 in the country for data centers. We need to pause.
context: Savannah-area campaign stop.

quote: [I would immediately] sign an executive order for that pause, and then we will determine what else we need to do administratively to take that pause into effect... I don't think we're going to get a lot of pushback across the state.
context: CBS Mornings interview, day after election; first commitment to an executive-order mechanism.

quote: I have also been clear that data centers in Virginia need to pay their fair share for energy consumption.
context: Budget negotiations statement.
source_name: Office of the Governor of Virginia

quote: This order makes sure that data centers are paying the full cost of the transmission infrastructure their developments require.
context: Statement on SCC order assigning transmission costs to data centers.
source_name: Office of the Governor of Virginia

quote: Starting today, this industry won't have carte blanche to play by their own rules in Virginia... We're not going to apologize for setting the highest standards.
context: Richmond press conference unveiling Data Center Accountability Framework (executive action).

quote: It's incredibly important that we have on-site generation.
context: Remarks backing a locally supported project with on-site power.

quote: The expansion of data centers across Loudoun County should have been done vastly differently. We are putting clear standards in place and ensuring that what has been permitted in years past is not permitted into the future.
context: October release on Loudoun County data-center standards.
source_name: Office of the Governor of Virginia
